title: Workflow
description: The document persisted in Supabase's public.workflows table (nodes/edges columns) and passed between the canvas, the save API, and the DAG executor. This is the message contract referenced by src/lib/types/workflow.ts (WorkflowNode, WorkflowEdge, WorkflowNodeData) as of the 2026-08-30 snapshot of the codebase — it is not an aspirational schema, it mirrors the TypeScript types the app already enforces at compile time.

id.description: Primary key of public.workflows. Generated by Postgres (gen_random_uuid()-style default).

user_id.description: Supabase auth user id. Nullable: the workflows RLS policy also permits rows with user_id IS NULL, so an unauthenticated/legacy row is a valid state, not a data-integrity error.

WorkflowNodeType.description: Canonical long form is preferred for new nodes (see NodePalette.tsx); short/legacy forms are accepted so workflows saved before the node-type rename keep working. Matching BOTH forms everywhere is enforced by the single isXNode() helpers in src/lib/ai/node-types.ts.

WorkflowNodeData.description: Superset of every node type's fields, since the app's own WorkflowNodeData interface stores them on one shared shape (with an index signature for anything not yet promoted to a named field) rather than a discriminated union. Which fields are meaningful depends on the sibling node's `type`.

output.description: Populated by the DAG runner after execution; empty/absent before a run.

model.description: Agent node only. A Groq model id (e.g. 'openai/gpt-oss-20b', 'openai/gpt-oss-120b') is routed to the Groq provider; anything else (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini') is routed to OpenAI. See GROQ_MODEL_PATTERN and getModelInstance() in src/lib/ai/dag-runner.ts — deprecated Groq ids (llama-3.1-8b-instant, llama-3.3-70b-versatile) are remapped rather than sent as-is.

value.description: User Input node: literal pasted/extracted text.

fileName.description: User Input node: original uploaded file name, when the value came from a file (PDF text extraction or Tesseract OCR).

query.description: RAG Filter node: the semantic query used to rank upstream chunks.

topK.description: RAG Filter node: number of top-ranked chunks to keep.

source.description: Source node id. Must match a WorkflowNode.id in the same workflow.

target.description: Target node id. Must match a WorkflowNode.id in the same workflow.

NodeExecutionLog.description: One row written to public.run_logs per node, per run (src/app/api/workflows/[id]/execute/route.ts). Streamed to the Execution Logs panel via Supabase Realtime on the run_logs table.

inputContext.description: Concatenation of this node's upstream parent outputs, as sent into the node.
